text: An abscess can be drained once its contents turn fluid — confirm this by inserting a clean needle into the softest part of the lump and drawing back a yellow, creamy liquid with a syringe. Then cut the abscess with a sharp blade at its base so it drains well, flush 2–3 times with running water, and apply iodine. Inject amoxicillin for 3 to 5 days (not into the abscess site itself).
